name: drilldownLabel
label: Drill down label
description: Text visible at the tooltip to help user understand what will happen on click.

name: enableDrilldown
label: Enable drilldown
description: When selected, enables an event handler to allow users to click a visualization value or section.

name: enableClickAndStay
label: Show selected data point
description: Use setting to visually show data point that has been selected/clicked on. Often can be used when the chart is acting as filter.

name: selectedElements
label: Selected elements for act as filter
description: List of selected elements when act as filter is enabled.

name: registerOrientation
label: Legend Orientation
description: Determines the layout of the legend within the visualization.

name: showDataTable
label: Show data table
description: Shows a table with chart and graph data for easier screen reader access.

name: chartSize
label: Chart size
description: Sets the size of the chart.

name: showDataLabels
label: Show data labels
description: Displays the score for each data point.

name: dataLabelsType
label: Data label type
description: Determines the amount of information to provide in the data label.

name: truncationType
label: Truncation type
description: Determines where to truncate long labels.

name: maxLabelSize
label: Max label size
description: Maximum size for the data labels, in characters.

name: showTotalValue
label: Show total value
description: Toggles the display of the overall total value of the visualization.

name: showMetricLabel
label: Show metric label
description: Shows the metric label.

name: showRegister
label: Show legend
description: Toggles the display of the legend on the visualization.

name: showRegisterValue
label: Show legend value
description: Displays the value corresponding to the area of the chart you hover on. The value displays as a tooltip and in the chart legend.

name: legendHorizontalAlignment
label: Horizontal alignment
description: Horizontal alignment of elements in the legend.

name: legendMaxItemWidth
label: Max legend item width, px
description: Defines number of pixels after which the item of the legend will be truncated.

name: legendExpandToFit
label: Expand legend vertically
description: When enabled, the legend will takes as much space as needed to fit legend without scrolling instead of maximum 2 lines.

name: registerPosition
label: Legend Position
description: Legend location relative to the chart.

name: showRegisterPercentage
label: Show legend percentage
description: Displays the percentage with the value in the legend.

name: showRegisterOnSameLine
label: Show value on the same line
description: Displays the value on the same line in the legend. When false, shows the value on a second line.

name: headerTitle
label: Chart title
description: Title for the visualization.

name: showPercentageOfTotalInTooltip
label: Show % of total in tooltip
description: Displays the percentage each data point contributes to the total. When enabled, percentages are shown alongside absolute values in the tooltip.
